summary: PM7's projection-pruning mechanism (eligibility predicate, bounded maintenance run, storage-pressure threshold, work_projection_pruned event, archived_work_linked projection) is deferred by decision rather than built: the authority guarantees (git note and domain_events authority, work-ID immutability, link-before-removal, git-rebuildable historical projections, live/historical query union, research cleanup) stand with executable evidence, live projections are accepted as unbounded at pre-floor scale with three recorded revisit triggers, and backup retention and VACUUM stay out of scope under PM10. Deliberate absences (core event pruning, WIP-byte CAS, process-exhaust receipts) stay absent. The PM7 coverage record closes as satisfied.
title: PM7 retention amendment — pruning deferred, authority guarantees kept
